body:
Part of the **Veles OTP external devices** RFC execution plan (OTP-25).

Per-user Windows and macOS packages with the specified install roots and Chrome manifest locations, exact-production-origin registration of host `me.nagaev.veles.bridge`, atomic upgrade/rollback, uninstall, Windows code signing, macOS signing/notarization/stapling, signed-to-unsigned content correspondence, release hashes/checksums, and separate scripted development registration/removal. No elevation, machine-wide registration, launch agents, or wildcard origins.

**Full task specification:** see section `### OTP-25` in the RFC: docs/rfcs/2026-08-21-otp-external-devices.md (PR #79) — https://github.com/raidenyn/veles-android/pull/79

The RFC body contains the authoritative **Outcome / Scope / Exclusions / Acceptance criteria / Verification evidence** for this task.

## OTP-23 carried-forward verification obligations


Tracking amendment from the post-grant review of #86 / PR #123 (baseline `cab043885ffe1991a6f3037c69a768ed6acbcd00`). These checklists assign future implementation/retest ownership; they do **not** mark a test PASS, waive a requirement, change dependencies, or authorize OTP-24. The current OTP-23 decision remains NO-GO until an explicit owner-approved gate amendment or satisfaction of its criteria. Only new-account W-01/M-01/M-02 are waived as nonblocking NOT RUN. Preserve earlier failed evidence and stable signing identities.

### Signing, development registration and authorization matrix
- [ ] Carry the early #86 macOS distribution/signing/permission-model decision into the actual pipeline: stable final bundle ID/team, usage descriptions, executable/package hashes, signing identity provenance, signature verification and required notarization/stapling. Local Apple Development signing is not CI/distribution provenance (M-03).
- [ ] **M-11 (not waived):** test the separately prepared unsigned dev-registered host on the EXISTING account: Chrome launch, authorization result, scan, cleanup and comparison with the approved signed fixture. Preserve the signed fixture, its signing identity and TCC state; do not replace it with an ad-hoc build or reset permissions. Record any human interaction honestly.
- [ ] Test grant retention/recovery across signed install, repair, update and rollback; verify stable identity rather than assuming a successful launch preserves authorization. Record exact prompt/Settings ownership when actually observable; link #88 and #104 for guidance.
- [ ] Maintain a reproducible test record of dev registration/removal and production exact-origin registration, with no elevation, wildcard origins or autostart.
The early viability/provenance investigation stays in #86; this issue owns implementation and full installer/distribution verification. It does not retroactively close OTP-23 M-03/M-11. Tauri retention solely for packaging is not approved; select the approved packaging path before making installer claims.
